playbookOutputs: Renewed CIDB Register of Contractors certificate
CRS confirmation of renewal with new expiry date
playbookCommonFailures: Registration already lapsed beyond the CIDB's grace period, so a new registration (not a renewal) is required
TCS PIN expired or company non-compliant at SARS
AFS older than 18 months for a graded contractor, so the CIDB downgrades on renewal
CIDB renewal fee unpaid (excluded from our fee), so the renewal sits unprocessed
CRS login details unknown or linked to a former employee's email

informationToProvide.label: Current CIDB registration certificate and details
informationToProvide.aiHint: The company's current CIDB certificate showing CRS number, grade(s), class(es) of works and expiry date. Read the expiry date — if it is already past, tell Kevin; the CIDB may treat it as a new application.

informationToProvide.label: Latest audited or independently reviewed financial statements (not older than 18 months)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed AFS for the latest financial year, year-end within 18 months of the renewal date. Not needed for Grade 1. For graded contractors the CIDB re-tests turnover and available capital on renewal — supply to avoid a downgrade.

informationToProvide.label: Company registration documents (e.g., CIPC CoR14.3)
informationToProvide.aiHint: CIPC CoR14.3 showing registered name, enterprise number and directors. Compare directors to those on the CRS profile — any change must be updated at renewal.

informationToProvide.label: Tax Clearance Status (TCS) PIN from SARS
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS Tax Compliance Status PIN letter for the company, unexpired. The CIDB verifies the PIN with SARS during renewal.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of public liability insurance (if applicable)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Insurance schedule or broker letter in the company's name showing public liability cover and period. Only required if the CIDB asks for it for the class / grade; otherwise optional.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect CIDB renewal requirements from client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certificate, CoR14.3, TCS PIN and CRS login received; AFS received for graded contractors
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Chase only what is missing. Explain that the CIDB re-verifies tax status on renewal and, for grades above 1, re-tests financials — so an unexpired TCS PIN and recent AFS avoid a downgrade. Ask whether any directors changed since registration. Remind that the CIDB renewal fee is payable by the client and excluded. Do not promise a shorter turnaround than 7–10 working days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify certificate, TCS and financials
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Expiry date read, TCS valid, AFS within 18 months where required, directors match
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Extract CRS number, grade(s), class(es) and expiry date from the certificate. Flag if expired. Check the TCS PIN expiry. For graded contractors check the AFS year-end is within 18 months and extract turnover and available capital (⚠ verify current CIDB definitions and thresholds) to confirm the current grade is still supported. Compare CoR14.3 directors to the CRS profile.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare renewal hand-off sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Hand-off sheet with renewal fields, any profile changes and grade-support figures posted for Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: List: CRS number, expiry, grade/class, TCS PIN, AFS figures used (turnover, available capital, largest contract), director / contact changes to update, and the CIDB renewal fee expected. Note plainly if the figures no longer support the grade so Kevin can warn the client before submission.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit renewal on the CIDB CRS portal
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Renewal submitted on CRS, fee reference recorded, confirmation saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Stage the renewal under the client's CRS login: update profile changes, attach TCS, AFS and insurance where required, and stop before the final submit for Kevin. Draft a client message with the CIDB fee amount and reference. Save the renewal confirmation.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for CIDB to process the renewal
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Renewed certificate available on CRS or a query raised
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check CRS status at each follow-up point; draft a status query to the CIDB quoting the CRS number if it has not moved. If the CIDB proposes a downgrade, create a proposal for Kevin and a client message explaining the reason and the upgrade route.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver renewed CIDB certificate to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Renewed certificate and new expiry date posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the certificate and note the new expiry date. Suggest diarising the next renewal 60 days before expiry and offer the CIDB Upgrade service if their financials support a higher grade.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
